props.gloss_en: R' Meir: [a woman who went out] with a ring that has a seal on it is liable to a sin-offering
Ulla: and the reverse of these [holds] for a man [i.e. a man is liable for a ring without a seal]
evidently Ulla holds: whatever is fit for a man is not fit for a woman, and whatever is fit for a woman is not fit for a man
shepherds go out in sacks; and not of shepherds alone did they say it but of any person -- only that it is the way of shepherds to go out in sacks
Rav Yosef: Ulla holds that women are a people unto themselves
one who finds tefillin brings them in pair by pair, a man and a woman alike
Abaye: but it [tefillin] is a time-bound positive mitzva
Abaye: and from every time-bound positive mitzva women are exempt
there [the tefillin baraita] -- R' Meir holds [as follows]
R' Meir: night is a time for tefillin
R' Meir: and Shabbat is a time for tefillin
so [for R' Meir] it is a positive mitzva not bound by time
and in every positive mitzva not bound by time women are obligated
but [going out wearing the ring] is carrying out in a backhanded manner
R' Yirmeya: we are dealing with a woman treasurer
Rava: sometimes a man gives his wife a ring with a seal to take to the box, and she puts it on her hand until she reaches the box
and sometimes a woman gives her husband a ring without a seal to take to a craftsman to fix, and he puts it on his hand until he reaches the craftsman

objections.gloss_en: מתיב רב יוסף: הרועים יוצאין בשקין ... ולא הרועים בלבד אמרו אלא כל אדם -- a garment that is one group's way is permitted to any person; so what is fit for one is not unfit for another

איתיביה אביי: המוצא תפילין מכניסן זוג זוג, אחד האיש ואחד האשה -- and if women are a people unto themselves, tefillin are a time-bound positive mitzva from which women are exempt [so how may a woman bring them in by wearing them?]

answered_by.gloss_en: התם קסבר רבי מאיר לילה זמן תפילין הוא ושבת זמן תפילין הוא -- for R' Meir tefillin are not time-bound, and women are obligated in them (= p_hatam_rabbi_meir, p_rm_tefillin_shelo_zman_grama, p_nashim_chayavot_shelo_zman_grama)

objections.gloss_en: והא הוצאה כלאחר יד היא! -- wearing a sealed ring on the finger is carrying out in a backhanded manner, so why is she liable?

answered_by.gloss_en: באשה גזברית עסקינן (= p_isha_gizbarit); conceded for a woman but found insufficient for a man by R' Yochanan, after which Rava answers with אלא
אלא אמר רבא: פעמים שאדם נותן לאשתו טבעת שיש עליה חותם להוליכה לקופסא ומניחתה בידה (= p_rava_isha_lakufsa)

objections.gloss_en: אמר רבה בר בר חנה אמר רבי יוחנן: תרצת אשה, איש מאי איכא למימר? -- for a man wearing a ring without a seal it is still carrying in a backhanded manner

answered_by.gloss_en: ופעמים שהאשה נותנת לבעלה טבעת שאין עליה חותם להוליכה אצל אומן ... ומניחה בידו (= p_rava_ish_leuman)
